messages:
nguyen: Quick heads-up — seeing 99th percentile per-token spikes on gpu-pool-3 during today's canary. Heatmap shows kernel-switch density aligning with spikes. Not sure if it's scheduler or kvcache churn.

sarah: Which metric exactly? token_latency_per_token_seconds or end_to_end?

nguyen: token_latency_per_token_seconds.p99 across routes. Also kernel_switch_count per-request jumps -> latency tails.

matt: FYI perf-bot reported canary deploy ok, but I saw increased small-batch ratio too. Could be batching heuristics falling back to delay-based batching.

lee: I profiled one instance — kvcache had ~18% miss rate with eviction thrash at 13:05; small batches mean more KV cache cold starts.

ana: (typo) -- ignore

ana: Can we add a composite panel in the latency explorer: overlay batch_size_hist, kernel_switch_rate, kvcache_hit_95? Should help correlate.

sarah: I sketched PromQL queries, dropping here:
```
# p99 per-token latency per route
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# kernel switches per second
sum(rate(kernel_switch_total[5m])) by (pool)

# batch size distribution (we push to a histogram)
rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])
```

matt: Nice. I'll add a 'scheduler fairness index' derived metric: (1 - normalized_variance(batch_wait_time)) to spot unfair queues.

perf-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T13:00:00Z completed. No infra alerts.

lee: Correlation matrix from my local run: kernel_switch_rate ↔ token_p99 = 0.72, kv_miss_rate ↔ small_batch_ratio = 0.65.

nguyen: Ok next steps: 1) add the composite panel to latency_explorer dashboard (matt), 2) emit kvcache_eviction_count as a tagged metric (lee), 3) alert on scheduler_fairness_index < 0.5 (ana) — I'll file the follow-ups.

ana: Also propose a quick dashboard panel for 'batcher_idle_pct' and 'batcher_blocked_time_ms' so we can differentiate batching starvation vs intentional delay.

matt: Will push dashboard change to staging in 10m and attach screenshots.

sarah: Thx. If alerts fire we'll triage on #eng-runtime-ops.

nguyen: thanks all. tagging @eng-sre for visibility :eyes:
